 댓글 신고
 A notified bank holiday usually means branches are closed and cheque clearing can pause, but digital rails such as UPI, IMPS, NEFT and RTGS typically continue to run. The practical check is which of your payments still depend on a branch or on a cheque, and whether a SIP or auto-debit instruction is set to a date your bank treats as a non-business day. Education only, not banking advice.
